chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Yamani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Two just persons among you' [5:95]. He said: 'The just ones are the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the Imam after him.'
Then he said: 'This is from what the scribes erred with (during the compilation) of the Quran'.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'two just persons' mentioned in Quran 5:95 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the phrase 'two just persons' (ذَوا عَدْلٍ) from Quran 5:95 as referring specifically to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the Imam who succeeds him. He notes that this specific identification is part of what the scribes omitted or erred in during the compilation of the Quranic text. This interpretation highlights the Shia doctrine of 'Ismah (infallibility) and the divine designation of the Imam, distinguishing the Ahl al-Bayt's unique status from the general concept of justice (Adl) applicable to others.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamany, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [5:95] as two just persons among you shall judge.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The just ones are Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and the Imam<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>saww</sup>’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is from what the scribes have erred with (during the compilation) of the Quran’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamaniy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the meaning of the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, ‘Two just people among you. . .’ [5:96] He (the Imam) said, ‘The just person is a reference to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and the Imam after him.’
He then said, ‘A mistake is made in it by the scribes (interpreters).”’
